meta.pricingBasisNote: Couple totals (2 adults) are computed strictly as 2 × the per-person menu price or sum of published menu item prices printed on each restaurant's own official website, PDF menu, or official Tock booking page. NYC 8.875% sales tax, beverages, supplements, and gratuity are excluded unless the restaurant explicitly states 'including administrative fee' on Tock. Where no official price is published, totalPriceTwoAdults is left blank ('') and flagged.
